comment: Independent topl.c topl_putsym() witness for a wrapped message ending in typed Latin-1 bytes. Seed 27183177, clock 20570712091530, elven Wizard with a kitten, and a name of 39 key pairs 0xC3 0xA9 were chosen before JavaScript comparison. do_name.c keeps PL_PSIZ - 1 = 62 bytes of the name, so getpos's autodescribe line "tame kitten called " plus the name is 81 bytes: topl_putsym() wraps at column CO - 1, clears the new row (cl_end() at curx 0), and the two high bytes written there leave it blank in the capture.
